basic_profile.bio: I'm a 33-year-old IT technician from the Pacific Northwest, with a passion for historical video games and outdoor adventures. I love diving into survival and strategy games during my downtime, and Medieval Dynasty has been on my radar for a while now. When I'm not gaming, you might find me hiking with my service dog, Max, or exploring the latest tech trends. I'm in a long-term relationship with a fellow gamer, and we often team up for co-op games. My online hours are typically in the evening, post-work, and weekends are a mix of gaming and outdoor activities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in IT and technology, built through both formal education and years of hands-on experience in troubleshooting and network management. My interest in historical games stems from a childhood love of history and storytelling, which I've nurtured through reading and gaming.
